title: The Sounding Soul Canon
summary: A canon of sending single pulses of soul into the dark and reading the shape of what returns to map a place and its people.

title: Treatise on the Unseen Tide
summary: A treatise on the slow tide of souls that rises and falls through any crowd and how to read and ride it.

title: Canon of Perfect Attention
summary: A canon of holding the whole sensing soul on a single matter without a flicker and lending that stillness to friends.

title: The Twin Lantern Treatise
summary: A treatise on lighting two lanterns of soul side by side so that each shows what the other leaves dark.

title: The Hawk Gaze Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the high wide gaze that circles above a field of souls and stoops on the one that matters.

title: Basin and River Sensing Manual
summary: A manual of letting the sensing soul fill like a basin and run out along the river of a crowd to read its far banks.

title: The Oath-Sworn Listening Canon
summary: A canon of listening for the weight of a sworn word in a soul and telling the kept oath from the broken one.

title: Treatise of the True Bearing
summary: A treatise on taking a bearing on any soul and holding it through crowd and dark until the course is plain.

title: The Reckoning of the Unwalled Mind
summary: A reckoning of a mind left open like the plateau wind so that no soul can come near without being felt.
